body: Android live pass, 2026-09-28, on main ba529de (onboarding, recorders and settings spec docs/specs/onboarding-recorders-settings.md, shipped in #228 to #230, plus recorder fixes #231).U+000AU+000AU+002A*Setup.** Plain profile APK built from a scratch worktree with testkit `patches/android-plain-build.patch` (applicationId `dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.plain`, label `field_notes_plain`, FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON, `lib/main.dart` target), installed beside the owner's real app `dev.satanshumishra.field_notes`, which was never touched. adb: `/opt/homebrew/share/android-commandlinetools/platform-tools/adb`; JDK 17: `/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home`; phone serial RF8MA2NA3ZM (Galaxy Note 10+, Android 12, gesture navigation, 1080x2280 at 420 dpi). Observation by `uiautomator dump` plus `screencap`; close-and-toast timing by a phone-side loop of `input tap` then repeated `screencap`. The owner allowed answering the test app's own microphone and camera prompts via adb; both were answered "Only this time" after checking the prompt named field_notes_plain.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Passed live.**U+000AU+002D Onboarding: welcome; six tips, each spotlight on its target (bottom bar, mood banner, + button, centred notes card listing Tables as supported, Calendar tab, settings gear); setup with the region suggestion first (Sunday, en-CA) and pre-selected; storage step with "My own server" exposed as disabled; summary without "Use defaults"; finish booked the 20:30 reminder.U+000AU+002D Skip path after `pm clear`: "Skip how it works" goes to setup; "Use defaults" shows "Defaults applied · change them in Settings" and writes reminder on at 8:30 PM, reflection question off, week start Monday; one reminder alarm per day was booked from 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-04 (a rolling window by design).U+000AU+002D Settings: four chips; the Reflection question row directly after Daily reminder, off on a new install; a Saturday week start reaches Calendar's first column; "Show tour" replays tips 1 to 6 with Back disabled on tip 1 and ends on Today after "Done"; Android system Back on replay tip 1 does nothing, as specified.U+000AU+002D Voice recorder: fills the screen; the shuffle is 48 dp tall and advances in order; the 4 s breath, "Start now" skipping it, and leaving during it recording nothing; recording, paused, "Let this one go?", Keep (a 0:18 entry saved, "Voice memo saved"); system Back in idle closes like Esc; the toast appears only after the 500 ms fade (phone-side frames show the fade with no toast, then the toast over Today, clear of the bottom bar).U+000AU+002D Video recorder: camera prompt; the timer beside the status; pause; self-view off hides the preview and shows the notice while recording continues; the camera chip is hidden while recording; the let-go toast appears after the fade; the camera is released afterwards (no active camera sessions).U+000AU+002D No crash-buffer entries and no Flutter errors in logcat.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Deferred defects** (owner decision 01M3NSEF6BWBWMHVN2F6TYZ16A; details in the thread's risks):U+000A1U+002E With self-view off, the notice says "The camera is still recording." while the status reads "Paused. Nothing's lost."U+000A2U+002E With the video let-go panel open, uiautomator shows one clickable 1080x2195 node labelled "Leave / What do you want to remember about today?" and no separate Leave node.U+000A3U+002E The camera chip shows "Back cam…" for "Back camera 1" on the phone.U+000AU+000AU+002A*To reproduce:** rebuild the plain APK from main with the patch (`flutter build apk --profile` with JAVA_HOME set as above), `adb install -r`, launch `dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.plain/dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.MainActivity`, finish or skip onboarding, open Record video (the phone has two cameras, so idle shows the chip truncation), record, turn self-view off, pause (issue 1), tap Let go (issue 2), then `uiautomator dump`. Uninstall the test app afterwards so its rolling reminder alarms stop.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Cleanup done:** the test app was uninstalled (its voice note and alarms went with it); phone scratch files under /sdcard/fn* were removed, including three uiautomator dumps from the morning session; the scratch worktree was removed. Evidence screenshots are in `~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/results/android/2026-09-28-ors-live/`.
